sentences.text: The prosecution case, in short, is that on 20/5/2025 at about 8 am, the applicant went to the residence of the victim where the victim and her family were residing on rent, when the 9 year old victim and her brother were there at home, with ulterior motives to commit sexual assault on the victim, dishonestly sent victim's brother to a shop to buy beedi for the applicant, criminally trespassed into the house, took the girl who was standing in the kitchen asking for a kiss, forcibly took her to the bed room, laid her on a cot, then committed aggravated sexual assault by kissing on her lips, fondled on her hands, when 2026:KER:27411 BAIL APPL. NO. 1704 OF 2026 the victim cried aloud, he covered victim's mouth forcefully, squeezed her neck and thereby committed the offences.
sentences._hearing_file: Manu vs State Of Kerala on 27 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: 4. I have heard Sri V.S Anu Mon, the learned counsel for the applicant and Sri. M.C Ashi, the learned Senior Public Prosecutor.

sentences.text: Perused the case diary.
sentences._hearing_file: Manu vs State Of Kerala on 27 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: 5. The learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
sentences._hearing_file: Manu vs State Of Kerala on 27 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: The counsel further submitted that no materials are on record to connect the applicant with the alleged crime; hence, he is entitled to bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Manu vs State Of Kerala on 27 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: On the other hand, the learned Senior Public Prosecutor submitted that the alleged incident occurred as a part of the intentional criminal acts of the applicant, and he is not entitled to bail at this stage.
